messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — pen test kickoff scheduled Tue 09:00 PST. Vendor (RedFoxSec) will test staging. They asked for read-only access + a KMS proof for keywraps. Need final checklist by EOD today.
ben: Can we avoid direct KMS key grants? prefer ephemeral assessor roles via our kms-proxy. @jamie is the proxy configured for assessor-scoped keys?
jamie: yes — proxy supports GenerateDataKeyEncrypted only. We'll rotate a wrapping key for the engagement window and issue ephemeral ARNs. No plaintext key sharing.
sam: re: RBAC, we need a group + role mapping. Proposal: group=pen-test-assessors, role=assessor-staging-readonly (s3:GetObject, logs:Read) + kms-proxy:Invoke. I'll open the JIRA after we agree.
elaine: perfect. also need audit sampling at 100% for the engagement window and a way to tag logs with engagement_id. jamie can you add the tag pipeline?
jamie: yep. we'll add header X-Engagement-ID and have log-processor set: engagement_id=1976543210. we'll persist full traces to the secure bucket and enable retention=90d for the bundle.
oncall: I'll be on the bridge Tue 09-11. please include oncall rotation in the runbook.
ben: small ops note — don't grant staging:Admin. Use this minimal IAM snippet for the role policy: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject","logs:DescribeLogStreams","logs:GetLogEvents"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-staging/*"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Invoke*"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/wrapping-key-197654"
    }
  ]
}
```
jamie: note above — kms:Invoke* will be proxied. the vendor will call our proxy endpoint; proxy enforces assessor label and logs request/response SHA.
elaine: remediation tracking: sam, please create an epic REDPT-197654 with sub-tasks for each vuln bucket (critical, high, medium). Link the epic to remediation-squad and set SLA: 14d for critical, 30d high, 60d medium.
sam: will do. naming: RED-PT-197654-EPIC. I'll create the epic and put a template checklist (evidence steps, test cases, owner).
ben: retest availability — propose Wed/Thu the following week (make sure vendors know we may throttle to dedicated pool). put tentative slots and let them pick.
jamie: also we need a pre-retest dry-run: export log snapshot + sign manifest. command for presigned export: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1976543210/logs.tar.gz --expires-in 3600`. attach manifest.json with checksums.
elaine: include runbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/pen-test-1976543210 and evidence checklist in the doc. I'll circulate final checklist in #eng-security by 17:00. :thumbsup:
secops-bot: Reminder — deploy-checklist job scheduled at 17:00 today. Logs will be archived to s3://redwood-pt-archive/1976543210 once checklist is confirmed.
oncall: confirmed. I'll start bridge invite and add calendar.
sam: epic created: RED-PT-197654 (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/RED-PT-197654). assigning initial triage to remediation-squad.
elaine: thanks all — last ask: any blockers on evidence export or RBAC before EOD?
ben: blocker: need infra approval for the ephemeral role ARN — @katie from infra is offline atm, pinging her DM.
jamie: if infra can't approve before EOD, we can scope a read-only limited window but make sure to log everything.
elaine: ok keep updates here. we'll escalate infra if no sign-off by 18:00.
